question: Who is the author of 'Sleeping on Jupiter', a novel longlisted for the Booker Prize in 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anuradha Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **'Sleeping on Jupiter'** is a novel written by **Anuradha Roy**, an acclaimed Indian author.
 
• The book was **longlisted for the 2015 Man Booker Prize**, one of the most prestigious literary awards globally.
 
• 'Sleeping on Jupiter' explores **themes of violence, love, loss, and the struggles of women** in a patriarchal society.
